verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents automatic suppression of unsubscribed, bounced, or spam-complaint contacts, nor that it is enforced across every send type. The closest items are adjacent: a default exclusion of unengaged contacts (graymail suppression), manual recipient exclusions, and a generic 'won't be sent for a specific reason' segment view that names no unsubscribe, bounce, or complaint reasons. None of these earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
